items.title: Isaias: Florida storm-related death toll rises to six (announced Tue, Oct 13)
items.summary: Gov. Ron DeSantis announced Tuesday, Oct 13 that Florida's storm-related death toll from Hurricane Isaias has risen to six. The six Florida deaths include two previously confirmed in Escambia County (a tree fell on a home; carbon monoxide from a generator running inside a garage); the four newly confirmed include a fatal car crash at an intersection where the traffic signal wasn't working and two deaths from storm-related disruptions to medical treatment (per Reuters). Fox Weather's detail: a woman killed when a tree fell on her Escambia County home and a man who died of CO poisoning from improper generator use; DeSantis said the new deaths were 'a little bit more post-storm.' Storm-wide Isaias toll is now 8 (6 FL + 2 AL, per Gov. Kay Ivey). Also in the Tuesday update: DeSantis said ~95% of customers' power restored; PowerOutage.com counts 45,000+ still without power Tuesday, mainly Escambia and Santa Rosa counties; Escambia County's initial damage estimate is ~$64 million for county repairs, emergency response and recovery.
